description:
Add telemetry events that let us observe the streaming render hot path and correlate it with keyboard latency. Register all events with `OctoPi.Tracer` so they flow to the existing `FileBackend` log.

## New events

| Event | Type | Metadata |
|---|---|---|
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :handle_info, :start \| :stop]` | `:telemetry.span` | `%{kind: :hid_event \| :octo_pi_agent_event \| :render_tick \| ..., mailbox_len_before}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, :start \| :stop]` | span | `%{streaming?, msg_count, line_count}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, :start \| :stop]` | span | `%{text_bytes, width, line_count, streaming?, msg_id}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :key, :latency]` | execute | `%{duration_us}` (arrival in `Terminal` narrowcast → handled in `Interactive`) + `%{key, mailbox_len_at_arrival}` |
| `[:octo_pi_tui, :interactive, :mailbox]` | execute | `%{message_queue_len}` (sampled at handle_info entry) |

## Required wiring

- Use `:telemetry.span/3` for duration events (start/stop pair, exception-safe).
- Capture key arrival timestamp at `Terminal` narrowcast (not at Interactive's `handle_info` — we want the queueing delay included).
- `mailbox_len_before` from `Process.info(self(), :message_queue_len)` at handle_info entry.
- `streaming?` metadata is load-bearing — without it we can't separate the per-chunk hot path from the final render.

## Tracer registration

In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/application.ex`:
- Extend the existing `:tui_render` group with `[:octo_pi_tui, :transcript, :render, ...]` and `[:octo_pi_tui, :markdown, :render, ...]`.
- Add a new `:tui_interactive` group at `:debug` for handle_info spans, mailbox samples, and key.latency.

## Acceptance

- All five events fire during a streaming run; `mix pi info trace` (or equivalent) shows them registered.
- Tracer file output contains a usable log of one streaming turn that can be filtered by event name.
- No regression in render frame timing on idle (handle_info span overhead is sub-millisecond).
title: Add render-path telemetry: handle_info spans, transcript/markdown spans, key latency, mailbox depth
